WITH status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(HGB) AS avg_hemoglobin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN T_BIL IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL THEN T_BIL / CRE END) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14'
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.CENTROMEA,
  s.avg_hemoglobin,
  s.avg_ratio,
  s.avg_ratio / o.mean_ratio AS normalized_ratio
FROM status_stats s
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.CENTROMEA;

assumptions.assumption: Comparison of the Date column with YYYY-MM-DD string literals ('1985-04-22' and '1994-03-14') applies correct chronological filtering despite the schema documentation suggesting YYMMDD format.
